use_cases.title: Which job titles are most related to a free-text phrase?
use_cases.description: Search-as-you-type / query understanding for a job board: map the phrase "machine learning" typed by a job seeker to the job titles it most strongly implies.

use_cases.title: What skills define a role (not just which are common)?
use_cases.description: Build a skills taxonomy / job description template. Relatedness ranks distinguishing skills above generic ones like "Communication" that are popular everywhere.

use_cases.title: Which roles need a given skill, and where are they hiring?
use_cases.description: Candidate recommendation: a candidate lists Kubernetes on their resume; find the roles that need it, then the locations most associated with each role (2-hop traversal).

use_cases.title: Which skills are emerging this year?
use_cases.description: Labor-market trend analysis: compare 2026 postings (foreground) with 2024 postings (background) to surface skills whose demand is growing.

use_cases.title: Score a candidate's skills against a target role
use_cases.description: Skill-gap analysis / resume scoring: rank the skills a candidate already has by how relevant they are to Data Engineer. Unrelated skills receive negative relatedness.

use_cases.title: Understand the intent behind a shopper's query
use_cases.description: Query classification for search relevance: route "cheap gaming laptop" to the right category, and find the brands and attributes it implies for boosting and facet pre-selection.

use_cases.title: Disambiguate an ambiguous query
use_cases.description: "laptop" means different things to different shoppers. Surface every interpretation with its distinguishing attributes to drive a "did you mean" or category picker.

use_cases.title: Related searches / query expansion
use_cases.description: Generate "people also searched for" suggestions and synonym candidates for a query from shopper behaviour.

use_cases.title: What is a brand known for?
use_cases.description: Merchandising and competitive analysis: the attributes and price bands that most distinguish Salomon products from the rest of the catalog.

use_cases.title: Differential diagnosis from presenting symptoms
use_cases.description: Given symptoms (multiple queries are ANDed), rank candidate conditions and the specialty to refer to. Synthetic data, for demonstration only, not medical advice.

use_cases.title: Typical treatments for a condition
use_cases.description: Care-pathway analytics: medications most associated with Type 2 Diabetes encounters.

use_cases.title: Comorbidity discovery
use_cases.description: Population health: which other conditions co-occur with Type 2 Diabetes more than chance would predict.

use_cases.title: Route a free-text clinical note to a specialty
use_cases.description: Triage: map unstructured note text ("heartburn") to a specialty and likely conditions.

use_cases.title: Auto-route a new support ticket
use_cases.description: Ticket triage: from the ticket text alone, predict the owning team and the most likely component.

use_cases.title: Detect what regressed in the latest release
use_cases.description: Release health / anomaly detection: compare tickets filed against v4.3 (foreground) with earlier releases (background) to find the issue types and components that spiked.

use_cases.title: Root cause and fix for an issue type
use_cases.description: Knowledge-base authoring: for Slow Performance tickets, find the components at fault and how each was usually resolved.
